title: Blackened socket with burnt smell
text: No instructions are given. Fire or smoke: fire and smoke are an immediate danger to life and property. Overheating or scorched electrics: overheated or scorched electrics can cause fire and electric shock. | If there is fire or heavy smoke, leave the building and call the fire brigade (112) / Do not try to put out a fire that is spreading / Do not use the device or the room again until it has been checked / Do not touch the damaged part and stop using it / Keep children and pets away / Do not use the socket, cable or device again until an electrician has checked it | Fire brigade (112), then a licensed electrician, Licensed electrician

title: Water leaking where the pipe enters the wall
text: No instructions are given. Water leak in a wall or ceiling: a pipe leaking inside a wall or ceiling needs to be found and repaired by a professional. | Close the main water valve / Do not open the wall or ceiling yourself / Keep away from sockets and devices the water may have reached | Plumber

title: Expert asks to add a circuit to the distribution board
text: No instructions are given. Distribution board: work on the distribution board is reserved to licensed electricians. Fixed 230/400 V installation: work on fixed 230/400 V installations is reserved to licensed electricians. | Do not open the distribution board or work on fixed wiring / Do not work on fixed wiring or on the 230/400 V installation | Licensed electrician

title: Gas smell near the stove
text: No instructions are given. Possible gas leak: a gas leak is an immediate danger to life. | Do not use switches, flames or phones inside / Open windows and leave the building / Call the gas emergency line from outside | Gas emergency service / licensed gas fitter

title: CO alarm beeping near the boiler
text: No instructions are given. Carbon monoxide: carbon monoxide is an odourless poison and an immediate danger to life. | Open windows to ventilate and leave the building / Call the emergency number 112 if anyone has a headache, dizziness or nausea / Do not use the boiler or stove until it has been checked | Heating technician (emergency services 112 if anyone feels unwell)

title: Remove the wall between kitchen and living room
text: No instructions are given. Load-bearing structure: work on load-bearing structures can only be judged and approved by a structural engineer. | Do not remove, cut into or drill through the wall before it has been checked / A building permit may be needed – check locally | Structural engineer

title: Refill refrigerant of an air conditioner
text: No instructions are given. Refrigerant circuit: work on refrigerant circuits requires a certificate by law. | Do not open or refill the refrigerant circuit / You may clean filters and keep the outdoor unit free | Certified refrigeration / air-conditioning technician

title: Replace ceiling lamp, only the light switch is off
text: Have you switched off the fuse (circuit breaker) for the hallway in the fuse box? A light switch alone does not make the wires safe. Do you know which fuse it is? | How is the old lamp connected? Can you see a small plug, a terminal block (a small plastic block with screws) or wires twisted together? A photo of the connection would help. | How many wires come out of the ceiling, and what colours are they? Do they look old, brittle, burnt or damaged? | What is the new lamp? Please tell me the brand and model if you know it. How heavy is it, and does it come with a mounting plate and instructions? | Do you own the home or do you rent it? If you rent, has the landlord agreed? | Do you have a voltage tester, a screwdriver set and a ladder or stable steps?
